blocks.text: LIMA, Peru — Scientists have identified a new lizard species in Peru’s Andes, the Natural History Museum of San Marcos University announced Saturday. Measuring about six to eight centimeters (2.4 to 3.2 inches) long, the lizard displays distinct coloration between males and females.
